info.title: Gremion kernel — governance surface
info.description: Documents the governance/groups/health HTTP surface of the Gremion governance kernel. v0.2.0 (breaking): the users-admin API (/api/users*) left the kernel with the users-admin module during the open-core carve. Contract-first: edit this spec in the same change as the route. Error envelope: {success:false, error:string}. Coverage and breaking-change gates: see contracts/README.md.

servers.description: The deployment this kernel is served from. Gremion is self-hosted: there is no canonical public instance, so `host` is a template variable and its default is an RFC 2606 example name, not a resolvable address. Set it to your own deployment host.

get.summary: List all org-units (committees/groups/council) — returns id+name+kind+visibility etc.; gated on Guest role (used by calendar filter chips)

403.description: Not authenticated or missing Guest role

post.summary: Create a committee org-unit (placement validated against the tenant org-schema) and provision its external resources (Keycloak group, Matrix room, Nextcloud folder)

parentId.description: Must reference an existing org-unit; its kind is checked by validateCreatePlacement against the tenant org-unit-kind catalog (P2.2 #202). Committees cannot be roots in the StuRa catalog, so null is rejected by the placement check.

400.description: Zod validation failure, parentId not found ('Übergeordnete Einheit nicht gefunden.'), or tenant org-schema placement rejection (validateCreatePlacement — P2.2 #202)

502.description: External provisioning failed — resources torn down, DB row removed (best-effort teardown guard)

get.summary: Get a single org-unit with its members, roles, and child org-units

data.description: OrgUnit fields spread with members (OrgUnitMember[]), roles (CommitteeRole[]), children (OrgUnit[]) — see getOrgUnit + listOrgUnitMembers + listRoles + getChildOrgUnits

patch.summary: Update an org-unit's name, description, or visibility

delete.summary: Delete an org-unit and deprovision its external resources; blocked if members/children/elections/protocols exist

207.description: Partial: some subsystem deprovisioning failed — row retained for retry

409.description: Conflict: has members, child orgunits, elections, or protocols

get.summary: List role-assignment history for an org-unit; user_keycloak_id is redacted for non-members unless caller is CouncilAdmin
List members of an org-unit, enriched with Keycloak display name and email

post.summary: Add a member to an org-unit and provision them in external subsystems

delete.summary: Remove a member from an org-unit and deprovision them in external subsystems

post.summary: Manually retry or reconcile provisioning for an org-unit

get.summary: List committee roles for an org-unit, each enriched with its current active assignment

items.description: CommitteeRole fields spread with currentAssignment (RoleAssignment | null) — see listRoles + getActiveAssignment

post.summary: Create a new committee role on an org-unit

get.summary: List standalone groups (kind='group' org-units) with provisioning resource status

post.summary: Create a standalone (root, kind='group') org-unit — root placement validated against the tenant org-schema — and provision its external resources

400.description: Zod validation failure, or tenant org-schema placement rejection — the org-unit-kind catalog must allow kind='group' as a root (validateCreatePlacement, P2.2 #202)

502.description: External provisioning failed — resources torn down, DB row removed (best-effort teardown guard)

get.summary: Get a Keycloak group by ID

delete.summary: Delete a Keycloak group by ID; requires it-admin role

get.summary: Public boot-status probe — 200 when boot is complete, 503 while migrating or if boot failed

503.description: Boot still in progress or boot failed

patch.summary: Update the child_term label of a committee org-unit (e.g. 'Referate' or 'Arbeitsgruppen'); an empty string clears the override back to the kind-catalog default

childTerm.description: '' clears the override: stored as NULL so the unit reverts to the tenant kind-catalog default child term (P2.2 #202)

200.description: Updated — child_term is null after a clear ('' request body)

400.description: childTerm not a string or exceeds 80 chars (SvelteKit throw error body)

403.description: Not CouncilAdmin or ITAdmin (SvelteKit throw error body)

404.description: Org-unit not found (SvelteKit throw error body)

post.summary: Assign a user to a committee role; archives the existing active assignment if present and schedules term-reminder notifications

bearerJwt.description: Keycloak-issued JWT for gremion-mobile (jwt-verify.ts; config-driven audience since P0.1)

kind.description: Tenant org-unit-kind catalog key (FK org_unit_kind.key, migration 038; P2.2 #202) — per-tenant catalog, not a closed union. StuRa default catalog: council | committee | group.

kind_label.description: Per-unit display-label override; null → tenant kind-catalog label (P2.2 #202, D-KL; migration 038)

authority.description: beratend vs beschließend (P2.2 #202, §3.5(d)); NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deciding' (migration 038)

voting.description: Member sits with a vote; sachkundige Bürger sit without one (P2.2 #202, §3.5(d)); NOT NULL DEFAULT true (migration 038)

CommitteeMember.description: OrgUnitMember enriched with Keycloak display name and email (null on lookup failure)

RoleAssignmentHistoryEntry.description: Archived role assignment; user_keycloak_id is '[redacted]' for non-members or '[gelöschtes Mitglied]' after GDPR erasure — see listHistory

user_keycloak_id.description: Keycloak user id, '[redacted]' for non-members, or '[gelöschtes Mitglied]' after GDPR hard erasure

SvelteKitHttpError.description: SvelteKit HttpError body produced by throw error(status, message) — shape {message:string}, NOT the GovernanceError envelope

ProvisioningReport.description: Result of a provisioning or deprovisioning orchestration run — see provisioning/types.ts ProvisioningReport
